1436-5261-7329.easyPrerequisites:
Your deck size is 2 or greater.
Call to Glory is exiled by Isochron Scepter.
Isochron Scepter doesn't have summoning sickness.
1436-5261-7329.notablePrerequisites: Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {2}.
1436-5261-7329.description:
Animate Isochron Scepter using Mind Transfer Protocol.
Activate any number of creatures by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Call to Glory without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Call to Glory, untapping all creatures you control and giving Samurai you control +1/+1 until end of turn
Repeat from step 2.

2167-3147-4548-5721.easyPrerequisites: You control lands that can tap to produce at least {7}{G}{G}{B} (but see notes).
2167-3147-4548-5721.description:
Activate Squandered Resources by sacrificing each land you control, adding at least {7}{G}{G}{B}.
Activate Aftermath Analyst by paying {3}{G} and sacrificing it, returning all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Azorius Chancery enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Takenuma from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Takenuma's channel ability by paying at most {3}{B}, milling three cards and returning Aftermath Analyst from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Aftermath Analyst by paying {1}{G}.
When Aftermath Analyst enters, it triggers, causing you to mill three cards.
Repeat
2167-3147-4548-5721.notes: Each legendary creature you control reduces the amount of mana required by {1}, up to a maximum of {3}. Each loop also has a chance to generate more mana than the one before it due to additional milled lands, so if you have excess mana you can begin the loop without the required number of lands and have a chance to achieve the infinite loop through milling.

710-4775-6495.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Danitha
When Danitha dies, Necrogen Communion triggers, returning Danitha from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Danitha enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Necrogen Communion from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Danitha.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.
710-4775-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

1643-2073-4050-7878.description:
Activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, returning Clown Car from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Clown Car enters, Kolodin triggers, causing Clown Car to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Clown Car.
When Clown Car dies, Salvaging Station triggers, untapping Salvaging Station.
Repeat.

851-7824-7858.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Hollowhenge Overlord triggers, creating four 2/2 Wolf creature tokens for each Wolf and/or Werewolf you control due to Adrix and Nev and Bard.
Repeat step 1 during each of your upkeeps. You'll create exponentially more Wolves each time assuming the Wolf tokens survive.
851-7824-7858.notes: The number of Wolves and/or Werewolves you'll control after performing steps 1 and 2 is equal to 5^X * Y, where X is the number of iterations of those steps you've performed (starting at 1), and Y is the initial number of Wolves and/or Werewolves you started with. So if you start with 6 creatures, you'll have 30 after the first iteration, 150 after the second, and so on. This also assumes no Wolves and/or Werewolves die, and no more are created during the turns.

475-1274-3197-7810.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
475-1274-3197-7810.description:
Gain life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token and an artifact token.
When the artifact token enters the battlefield, Leonin Elder triggers, causing you to gain 1 life
Repeat from step 2.

475-1274-4186-7810.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
475-1274-4186-7810.description:
Gain life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token and an artifact token.
When the artifact token enters the battlefield, Leonin Elder triggers, causing you to gain 1 life
Repeat from step 2.

4496-5220-6900-7192.description:
Cast Accursed Centaur by paying its mana cost.
Activate Accursed Centaur by sacrificing it.
When Accursed Centaur dies, Mortuary and Grave Venerations trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Accursed Centaur from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Grave Venerations trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Cast Accursed Centaur from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

1453-4559-5686-7306.notablePrerequisites: Noncreature artifacts you control have total mana value 11 or greater.
1453-4559-5686-7306.description:
Cast Metalwork Colossus by paying {0}, which enters with at least two +1/+1 counters on it due to Arwen.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Metalwork Colossus.
When Metalwork Colossus dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen token for each +1/+1 counter Metalwork Colossus had.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate Metalwork Colossus by sacrificing two Mutagens, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

4927-6738-7011-7082.easyPrerequisites: You control three or more Allies.
4927-6738-7011-7082.description:
Cast Razor Boomerang by paying {0} due to Sokka, Swordmaster.
When Razor Boomerang enters, Sokka and Suki's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token.
When the Ally enters, Sokka and Suki's first ability triggers, attaching Razor Boomerang to the Ally token.
Activate the Ally token by tapping it and unattaching Razor Boomerang, dealing 1 damage to any target and returning Razor Boomerang from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

296-3532-5078-6289.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
296-3532-5078-6289.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
The Thirteenth Doctor triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

539-997-7031.description:
Cast Badgermole by paying its mana cost
When Badgermole enters, its earthbend ability triggers, causing it to earthbend itself as it is a Forest due to Ashaya.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Badgermole
When Badgermole dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Badgermole enters, its earthbend ability triggers, causing it to earthbend itself as it is a Forest due to Ashaya.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

107-2292-6972.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Ambitious Aetherborn.
When Ambitious Aetherborn dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Ambitious Aetherborn enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

2653-4365-5702-6973.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
2653-4365-5702-6973.description:
Play a land.
When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of Mutable Explorer.
When the Mutable Explorer tokens enter, they trigger.
Resolve the first Mutable Explorer trigger, creating two Mutavault land tokens that enters tapped.
When the Mutavault tokens enter, Springheart Nantuko and Nissa each trigger twice.
Resolve the Nissa triggers, adding {1}{G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of Mutable Explorer.
Repeat from step 3.

2173-2448-4699-5220.easyPrerequisites: It is your precombat main phase.
2173-2448-4699-5220.description:
Activate Goblin Firestarter by tapping and sacrificing it.
When Goblin Firestarter dies, Mortuary and Overgrowth Elemental trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Goblin Firestarter from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Overgrowth Elemental trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Goblin Firestarter ability.
Cast Goblin Firestarter from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

1563-2457-4321-5223.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token and a Food token.
Activate the Insect and Food by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

2034-2178-6773.easyPrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard
2034-2178-6773.description:
Activate Xu-Ifit by tapping it, returning a creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the creature returned in step 1.
When the creature dies, Xu-Ifit triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.

913-3525-4131-6657.description:
Activate Basalt Monolith's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Basalt Monolith's second ability by paying {3}.
Holding priority, activate Gogo by paying {6} and tapping it, copying Basalt Monolith's ability three times.
Resolve a copy of Basalt Monolith's ability, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Basalt Monolith's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Repeat from step 4 two additional times.
Activate Signpost Scarecrow by paying {2}, adding {U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Gogo.
Repeat from step 3.

997-2178-3362-6542.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken Dragon with mana value 6.
997-2178-3362-6542.description:
Activate Sidisi by tapping it and sacrificing a nontoken Dragon with mana value 6.
When the creature dies, Sidisi triggers, untapping Sidisi.
Resolve the Sidisi ability, returning Bladewing from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Bladewing enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning the Dragon with mana value 6 from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Bladewing.
When Bladewing dies, Sidisi triggers, untapping Sidisi.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Valentin, Dean of the Vein // Lisette, Dean of the Root

3097-3490-4446-4659.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one Cleric
You control an additional creature.
3097-3490-4446-4659.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing a creature, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Relic Vial triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Lisette triggers, causing you to pay {1} to put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Animation Module triggers for each counter placed this way.
Resolve the first trigger, choosing to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Resolve all other triggers, choosing not to pay.
Repeat.

323-1461-4050-4078.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Wurmcoil Engine, adding {B}.
When Wurmcoil Engine dies, it and Falkenrath Noble trigger.
Resolve the Wurmcoil Engine trigger, creating two 3/3 Wurm artifact creature tokens.
Resolve the Falkenrath Noble trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and an opponent to lose 1 life.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the Wurm tokens, adding {B}{B}.
When the Wurms die, Falkenrath Noble trigger twice, causing you to gain 2 life and an opponent to lose 2 life.
Activate Chainer by paying {B}{B}{B} and 3 life, putting Wurmcoil Engine from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
Repeat.
